plotEn:
A Long Winter is a 2026 drama film written and directed by Andrew Haigh, based on the 2006 short story by Colm Tóibín, and is a co-production of Canada and the United Kingdom. It stars Fred Hechinger, Ebon Moss-Bachrach, Caitríona Balfe, Kit Connor, D'Pharaoh Woon-A-Tai, David Furr, Manuel Garcia-Rulfo, and Martin Freeman.
